Privacy

This demonstration does not collect personal data.

Fieldnotes currently has no accounts, forms, analytics, cookies, database, or third-party tracking. It presents the static sample content from the ASP.NET Core MVC project.

Current behaviour

The hosted showcase returns static pages and does not intentionally persist visitor information.

Future features

If accounts, comments, analytics, or other data-processing features are added, this page should be updated before those features are published.
